name: Derwent Valley Mills
countries: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
description: Along the River Derwent in Derbyshire, England, this string of 18th-century cotton mills is where the modern factory was born. At Cromford, Richard Arkwright harnessed water power to spin cotton nonstop, then built housing for his workers nearby. You can still see mills and streets of workers' homes at Cromford, Belper, Darley Abbey and Milford, and some mills now house museums.
